notes.title: Announced DLC: Prisoner - The Mystery Complex
notes.content:
I'm glad to present first big DLC: Prisoner - The Mystery Complex!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/4e5405cc965d2c5aaad5c8310a04de6a4bf50b33.jpg

In endless attempts to find a way out, the character accidentally activates additional systems of Complex. Now, he will have to face new traps and trials.
The DLC includes a lot of new content.

Features:

New stage - Outer Complex


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/6e675037d504e880fa7b95931ac139be193b4ef3.png

Find the Complex control room and activate external systems to gain access to the new stage. Each level contains lots of new traps, from lightnings to x-rays.

---

New game mode - Endless Complex


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/79d0e4098800f1789b32a5d0e84100eb4fc22b67.png

Practice your skills and pass as many rooms as possible in the Endless Complex mode. For every 25 rooms you will receive a reward, and the traps will become even stronger.

---

New game mechanic - Mystery Mechanism


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/c21e7f2070b33ace769f646330bfadbcb87940a1.png

Now you can find mechanisms, that will randomly give you either positive or negative effect on a random amount of levels. Activate them at your own risk.

---

Character skins


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29513357/64b1e25022322b033b750d022694f2bea98d0697.png

Unlock additional character skins for passing the trials and levels. The harder the trial, the better the reward.

---


	 New levels
	 New traps
	 Achievements


Prisoner - The Mystery Complex will be available November 8, 2017

notes.title: Prisoner - Release Build #71327
notes.content:
General

	Improved graphic quality at all levels
	All in-game sounds have been normalized
	Start room has been rebuilt
	Added some DLC sprites at start room
	Special application branch is no longer supported

Traps

	Fixed light sources at some traps
	Fixed animations at laser traps

Bugs

	Fixed character physics
	Fixed character movement animation
	Fixed error at "Trial of Darkness" walkthrough
	Fixed incorrect UI display at "Trial of Death" walkthrough

Misc

	Settings: Maximum brightness has been increased from 0.1 to 0.3
	Character: Jump height has been increased by 0.05
